'''Avril Gresh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who became a ''acquisitions specialist'' for the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]].

==Biography==
Lacking studies, Gresh began working in a big agri-collective in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The farmers there were receiving harsh treatment by the enforcers of the Company. After Gresh failed to fulfill his yearly quota, he was called for a reprimand by the farm overseer. During the argument, Gresh killed his overseer, and then ran away to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to avoid prosecution. Gresh was found by a Karazak [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]], who recognized Gresh's natural managing skills. The slaver offered Gresh a job in the Karazak Cooperative, and threatened to denounce him should he refuse. Gresh accepted and became an acquisition specialist.

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Gresh was trying to save some money to retire and allow [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to forget him. He had decided that he did not mind if others suffered as a consequence.
